rows.en:
That man… You mean [HERO2]?

He's our comrade, fighting evil organizations together with [HERO4].

I see… You've wormed your way in nicely, Lucifard!

Or rather… should I call you a top executive of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager?
What on earth are you talking about, Gavan?
Everyone, don't be fooled! This man is the enemy!!
What!?
Why don't you say something? Galactic Union S-class most wanted fugitive Lucifard!
[HERO2]! Is what Gavan's saying true?
"It's true…" "I don't need to answer that."
It's just as Gavan says… I was once with the Battle Fleet Nation Naager.
Lucifard, you're under arrest! I don't need to read you your rights, do I? Now, come quietly…

Wait! Ever since that battle, [HERO2] has been like a different person…

Most likely, he awakened to his own self… Now… now he has a righteous heart…!
It's all right, [HERO4]… My hands are already stained with blood. There's no talking my way out of this.
There's something I have to do. I don't want anyone getting in the way of it.
That won't fly! Lucifard, you're under arrest!
I won't let you get in [HERO2]'s way.

I've just set up a directional energy-reactive field around this area!

If you use firearms, they'll explode…
What!?

Well done, [HERO4]!

Hongo, after doing something like this, I won't ask you to believe me, but I wanted to fight alongside all of you. Like this, forever…

Let's go, [HERO4]!!
W-wait, [HERO2]!
Damn… He got away!?
Shocking words, brought by Space Sheriff Gavan… Is Lucifard truly the enemy, as he says!? What is the Battle Fleet Nation Naager?
A dark shadow fell over the heroes' unity…

A scientific crime syndicate that manipulates all the evil in the universe from the shadows and has conquered countless planets.

The one who rules that beast-star empire with overwhelming power is Don Horror!
I see, so that's the space crime organization Makuu…
I've heard about you all from Commander Kom, through the TDF. Let's fight for the peace of Earth!!
Yeah… Likewise, we're counting on you.
Defeat Beast Alien Doubleman and all Crusher Soldiers! Also, capture the laboratory, the factory and the power plant!
Space Sheriff Gavan, dispatched by the Galactic Union Police of Planet Bird, took his mother's surname and came to call himself Retsu Ichijouji.
The words he brought, that Lucifard is the enemy… sent a shock through the warriors who had fought alongside Lucifard until now.
It's not that I don't believe you, but did you really fight [HERO2]?

Yeah… Originally, I was supposed to be posted to Earth much sooner.

But… on my way to Earth, near Jupiter, I ran into this Lucifard!

You wouldn't know it… but he's wanted by the Galactic Union Police.

I fought him in space to capture him. It was a truly fierce battle…

But… I couldn't arrest Lucifard, and my Dolgiran was half-destroyed!

So… after repairing my ship, I came to Earth all over again.
Wanted…? What on earth did he do?
Invasion and sabotage of other planets… In other words, he's done the same things as Shocker and Makuu… this guy!!
Is that true!? [HERO2]?

He's not lying!

Once… I spread misery across countless planets with these very hands…

So you finally admit it…

[HERO2] Sakomizu… no, Lucifard!

I'm sorry, but you're under arrest! You'll face judgment on Planet Bird. I'll have you come along quietly.

Don't worry about it, [HERO4]… It was my fate to end up like this anyway!

Hongo, everyone… It's true that what I've done is as cruel as it gets. But I want you to believe this one thing…

I never approached you with the intention of deceiving you…
[HERO2]…

In any case… I have to escort [HERO2] to Planet Bird.

I'm counting on you to take care of Earth!
What!? A secret transmission has come in for me?
Eeee! It's being sent by breaking into the executives-only line!
Nngh… Who could it be?
Hm, wh-who is it!? Who dares send telepathy directly to me?
Wh-what is the matter, Lord Emperor Banba?

Silence! To call me, the Emperor of the Neo-Human Empire, directly… This one has nerve…

Interesting… Send soldiers to this one's location!! I shall try speaking to them from here, using the communicator.
Yes, sir!!

Hm? There is someone else sending a transmission?

…You're Shocker's Doctor Death!?

Well, well… If it isn't Emperor Banba of the notorious Neo-Human Empire!

Transmitting on our Shocker's executives-only line… that's hardly peaceful, is it?

Summoning me all the way here… What exactly do you intend to do?

…!?

It seems the sender of the transmission wasn't you after all, Lord Banba… You there, who are you?
I am not your enemy… Doctor Death, and Lord Emperor Banba. It was I who summoned you both.
To send telepathy directly to me… you are no ordinary being, are you? State your name.
I am an envoy from the Battle Fleet Nation Naager: Apfaron, the Evil Scholar.

Naager, you say… I don't know the name.

So… what business does this Naager have with us? Depending on your answer, you won't leave here alive.

Yes… In truth, I have come to sell you weapons of invasion.

We of Naager are a people who travel from star to star across the universe, dealing in weapons we have developed ourselves.

I have come to humbly ask that you make use of our Naager's weapons for your invasion of Earth.
Interesting! Show me these weapons of yours…!
This is bad!
Apparently some unidentified flying objects have appeared in the Keihin industrial zone and are running wild! It sounds like the TDF has asked Unicorn's Japan Branch to send out Giant Robo…
What!? All right, let's head there too!!
Now then… please enjoy the full extent of my forces.
Splendid… Truly splendid combat power! Apfaron…
Thank you very much.

Giant Robo, eh…

Apfaron! Show me these "Kelbaan" fighters fighting Giant Robo, banbaaa!
That's easily done…

That was a tough opponent…

I don't think those were BF fighters. Whose fighters could they be?

Could it be a new enemy? I can't just sit here… Robo, let's head back to base!
Hmm, they were defeated… but I like the fighters' performance itself! Apfaron, what is it you want?
Heh heh heh… Surely you don't intend to lend us a hand for nothing?

Merely being granted an audience with the great Shocker and the Neo-Human Empire on this occasion is an honor in itself…

Therefore… I intend to present these weapons free of charge, as a token of our acquaintance.

What!? You say you want no reward!?

Hmph… It's hard to believe, but very well.

…!?

That's… Shocker!?

The Neo-Humans are with them too!?

What on earth are they plotting!?
Hm, so they've appeared… Go, Phantom Soldiers!

So these are the ones who get in your way?

Please leave this to me. I had been hoping for a chance to cross swords with them…
Very well… Then I shall await good news!
Yes…

…!?

Who are you? You don't seem to be Shocker… or a Neo-Human either. A new enemy… All right, here I come!!
This is your last look at Earth, isn't it? [HERO2]…
Do as you like…

…!?

Mimi, what's wrong? What happened!?

Gavan, it's terrible!

Apfaron has appeared in the Keihin industrial zone!
What!?

U01302/U01303: one heroine line split across a dialogue row and a narration-kind row
U01332: sender unknown to Banba; used 'this one' / 'them' (gender-neutral)
U01349: Banba's tic バンバー rendered 'banbaaa'
